question: Identify the top 10 liquor categories in Iowa in 2021 by calculating, for each category, the average of the per-liter retail prices across all sales transactions in that category during 2021. For these top categories, provide their average per-liter retail prices calculated in the same manner for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
sql:
WITH top10_2021 AS (
  SELECT category_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2021
    AND bottle_volume_ml > 0
  GROUP BY category_name
  ORDER BY AVG(state_bottle_retail / (bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0)) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  t.category_name,
  AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2019 THEN s.state_bottle_retail / (s.bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0) END) as avg_per_liter_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2020 THEN s.state_bottle_retail / (s.bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0) END) as avg_per_liter_2020,
  AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2021 THEN s.state_bottle_retail / (s.bottle_volume_ml / 1000.0) END) as avg_per_liter_2021
FROM top10_2021 t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
  ON t.category_name = s.category_name
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
  AND s.bottle_volume_ml > 0
GROUP BY t.category_name
ORDER BY avg_per_liter_2021 DESC
